lightIdle: Ngolang aterese efe kapa efe ea sebaka sa marang-rang. Re hlahloba lethathamo la rona la litšokelo, sebopeho, ho etsisa merka, DNS le karabo ea hona joale. Ho Ema: tloha, netefatsa ka mocha oa semmuso oo u seng u o tšepile, ebe u tlaleha ha u rata.
lightLimited: E hloekile e bolela hore litlhahlobo tse entsweng ha lia fana ka temoso e matla — ha se tšepiso ea hore sebaka se bolokehile.
privacyNote: Ka tlhophiso: ha ho bolokoe letho. Tlhahlobo ea liphoso e thusa ho lokisa mathata a thekniki feela — ha ho mohla aterese, le ha ho mohla bakeng sa phatlalatso.
privacyOff: Se ke oa boloka le ka mohla
privacyShare: Tlhahlobo ea liphoso bakeng sa tšehetso
privacyPolicyIntro: Sesebelisoa sa buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (mola oa lihlahisoa tsa Buusdo — sehlahisoa se arohaneng) se u thusa ho hlahloba aterese ea sebaka pele u e tšepa. Litlhahlobo li sebelisa matšoao a rona le lethathamo la rona la litšokelo le hlokomeloang. Leqephe lena ke tsebiso ea lekunutu ea sehlahisoa bakeng sa sebaka sa marang-rang, katoloso ea sebali, le app ea teseke.
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Ha u etsa tlhahlobo, aterese eo u e kenyang e sebetsoa seva ea buusdo ho sekaseka sebopeho, ho bapisa le lethathamo la rona la litšokelo, ’me ka khetho ho lekola ho fihlella ha hona joale (DNS / HTTP). Ha re romelle li-URL tse hlahlobiloeng ho Google Safe Browsing kapa ho li-API tse ling tsa botumo ba motho oa boraro, ’me ha re rekise datha ea tlhahlobo.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Ka tlhophiso: ha ho bolokoe letho. U ka khetha poloko ea sesebelisoa sena feela (mananeo a thibelo/tšepo, nalane ea tlhahlobo ka khetho) sebaling, katolosong, kapa app ea teseke. Tlhahlobo ea liphoso bakeng sa tšehetso e kenyelletsa mohloli le mofuta oa tšokelo feela — ha ho mohla aterese e felletseng, ’me ha ho mohla bakeng sa phatlalatso kapa papatso.
privacyPolicyAccountTitle: Ha ho lumellano ea akhaonto ea leru
privacyPolicyAccountBody: buusdo ha e fane ka akhaonto ea leru kapa lumellano ea mananeo lipakeng tsa lisebelisoa. Mananeo a hau a thibelo/tšepo a lula sesebelisoeng sena. A khutlisetse ka ho romela ntle kapa ho kenya JSON kapa QR ea shield-lists-v1, kapa u lumellanye ka bowena faele ea shield-backup.json ea teseke (USB, Drive, Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Bakeng sa lipotso tsa lekunutu kapa tsa sehlahisoa, ikopanye le mosebeletsi oa ho kenya ha hau ha buusdo ka imeile ea hae ea semmuso kapa mocha oa tšehetso (motho kapa mokhatlo o tsamaisang Cloudflare Worker). Khetha aterese eo ea semmuso eo u e tsebang — eseng mohala kapa imeile e hatisitsoeng sebakeng seo u se hlahlobang. Se ke oa manamisa liphetho tsa tlhahlobo tse bobebe mecheng ea sechaba.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: Ha ho ho qhaqha ha TLS — HTTPS CONNECT ke lebitso la moamoheli feela; ha ho setifikeiti sa MITM. Ha ho polao ea tšebetso — mananeo a sebetsang a tsoela pele. Li-directory tsa sistimi ke tlaleho feela — /usr, /etc, litsela tsa sistimi tsa Windows, le Program Files ha li mohla li sisinngoe kapa li lokisoe. Ha ho enjene ea AV kapa ea litšoao, ’me ha ho ho hapa liphasewete kapa nalane ea ho bala.
privacyPolicyUpdated: E hlahlobiloe qetellong: 2026-11-07 · ho qala ha sebaka sa marang-rang
desktopDownloadsIntro: Kenya buusdo k’homphuteng ena ho tsoa ho GitHub Release (khetla ea sebali + trey). Meaho ha e saenoe — bona tataiso ea ho kenya. Ho bula ha u kena ho lula ho timiloe ho fihlela u e bula.

nextStepVerifyOfficial: Netefatsa ka boikemelo: bula domain kapa app ea semmuso ea mokhatlo oo u seng u o tšepile (bokemaka, karete ea banka, lebenkele la li-app le tsebahalang). Se ke oa sebelisa mehala kapa li-imeile tse bontšitsoeng leqepheng le belaetsang.

nextStepLooksReal: Maqephe a bolotsana hangata a shebahala a hlokisisitsoe ’me a sebelisa HTTPS. Boleng ba pono ha bo pake hore sebaka se molaong.
honestLimitsTitle: Mellwane e tšepahalang ea sesebelisoa sena
honestLimitNoWipe: buusdo ha e khone ho hlakola tlhahisoleseding ea motho eo sebaka se seng se e bokelletse. Fetola liphasewete sebakeng sa ’nete sa semmuso haeba u kentse letho, ’me u shebe litemoso tsa banka/imeile.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Liphetho li tsoa lethathamong le hlokomeloang le matšoao a aterese a buusdo — eseng palo ea sechaba ea hore ke batho ba bakae ba tlalehile sebaka.
honestLimitNoAv: Sena ha se sehlahisoa sa antivirus. Ho koala thebe ho emisa ho kenya datha mona; ha e sikeine kapa e hloekise sesebelisoa sa hau.
actionSensitiveNote: Se ke oa kenya tlhahisoleseding e bobebe ntle le haeba u ka netefatsa aterese ka mohloli o ikemetseng.

faqNoWipeTitle: Na buusdo e ka hlakola datha eo sebaka se seng se e nkile?
faqNoWipeBody: Che. Fetola liphasewete sebakeng sa ’nete sa semmuso haeba ho kentsoe letho, ’me u shebe litemoso tsa banka kapa tsa imeile.
faqNoAvBody: Che. Ho koala thebe ho emisa ho kenya datha e eketsehileng atereseng eo; ha e sikeine kapa e hloekise sesebelisoa.
faqNoCrowdTitle: Na lintlha li tsoa likhethong tsa basebelisi ba bang?
faqNoCrowdBody: Che. Liphetho li sebelisa lethathamo la litšokelo le hlokomeloang la buusdo le matšoao a aterese — eseng palo ea sechaba ea hore ke batho ba bakae ba tlalehileng sena.
protection: Sebelisa katoloso kapa app ea teseke ho nchafatsa mananeo a tšireletso.
currentlyBlocked: e thibetsoe katolosong kapa app ea teseke ha u e eketsa moo.
removed: E tlositsoe ho datha ea sebaka ea lehae:
reset: Hlakola datha ea sebaka e bolokiloeng
resetDone: Nalane ea lehae, lingoloa, le linotlolo tsa lethathamo tsa khale li hlakotsoe.
blockListsWebsiteNote: Sebaka sena ha se qobelle mananeo a thibelo/tšepo (katoloso le teseke li etsa joalo). Mananeo a lula sesebelisoeng.
blockListsOfflinePath: Tsela lipakeng tsa lisebelisoa: romela ntle kapa kenya JSON kapa QR ea shield-lists-v1 katolosong kapa app ea teseke. Teseke e ka boela ea lumellanya shield-backup.json ka USB, Drive, kapa Syncthing — ha ho akhaonto ea leru.
blockListsOfflinePageLink: Tataiso ea ho tsamaisa mananeo ntle le inthanete
listsOfflineTitle: Tsamaisa mananeo ntle le akhaonto ea leru
listsOfflineIntro: Mananeo a thibelo le a tšepo a lula sesebelisoeng se seng le se seng. Ha ho akhaonto ea leru ea buusdo. Sebelisa ho romela ntle/ho kenya kapa lumellano ea faele.
listsOfflineStepExport: Katolosong kapa app ea teseke, romela ntle shield-lists-v1 (JSON kapa QR).
listsOfflineStepMove: Kopitsa faele kapa skena QR sesebelisoeng se seng (USB, Drive, molaetsa oo u o romellang uena).
listsOfflineStepImport: Kenya sesebelisoeng se seng. Ho molemo mongoli a le mong ka nako.
listsOfflineDesktopBody: App ea teseke e boloka mananeo e le shield-backup.json foldareng ea datha ea eona. U ka lumellanya foldara eo ka Syncthing, Drive, kapa USB. Haeba lisebelisoa tse peli li ngola ka nako e le ’ngoe, romela ntle hape ho sesebelisoa seo u se tšepileng ’me u kenye ho se seng.
listsOfflineDocsLink: Lintlha tse felletseng tsa lumellano ntle le inthanete (litokomane)

accountDisabled: Lumellano ea akhaonto e timiloe seva ena (ACCOUNT_SYNC_ENABLED). Sebelisa poloko ea ntle le inthanete ka tlase, kapa kopa mosebeletsi ho bula lumellano.

accountMagicSent: Haeba aterese eo e ka amohela mangolo, lehokelo la ho kena le rometsoe (ntlhafatso e ka bontša lehokelo ka tlase).

accountSignedOut: U tsoile. Mananeo a leru ha a hlakoloa.
accountDeleted: Akhaonto le mananeo a leru li hlakotsoe.
accountSignOutNote: Ho tsoa ha ho hlakole mananeo a leru. Ho hlakola akhaonto ho etsa joalo.
accountOfflineBackup: Poloko ea ntle le inthanete: romela ntle kapa kenya JSON kapa QR ea shield-lists-v1 ho tsoa katolosong kapa app ea teseke.

probeBlocked403Title: Sebaka se hanne tlhahlobo e iketsang
probeBlocked403Detail: Ho amohetsoe HTTP 403 (Forbidden). Sebaka se hanne tlhahlobo ena e iketsang — seo ha se bopaki ba bolotsana. Leka aterese sebaling se tloaelehileng ha ho hlokahala.
probeBlocked429Title: Sebaka se fokolitse tlhahlobo e iketsang
probeBlocked429Detail: Ho amohetsoe HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). Sebaka se fokolitse tlhahlobo ena — seo ha se bopaki ba bolotsana. Emela ’me u leke hape, kapa bula aterese sebaling se tloaelehileng.
probeBlocked503Title: Sebaka ha se fumanehe ka nakoana tlhahlobong
probeBlocked503Detail: Ho amohetsoe HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable). Sebaka kapa moeli o ka ’na oa imeloa — seo ha se bopaki ba bolotsana. Leka hape hamorao sebaling se tloaelehileng ha ho hlokahala.

levelLowEvidenceNote: Ha ho tšokelo e tsejoang e fumanoeng mehloling e hlahlobiloeng.
levelUnknownNote: Ha ho bopaki bo lekaneng ho fihlela qeto e kholisehang.
recommendationLeaveAndBlock: Tloha ’me u thibele domeine ena (katolosong kapa app ea teseke)
desktopBlockNeedOpen: Bula app ea teseke ea buusdo pele (localhost:3010), ebe u leka hape.
evidenceKnownThreatDetail: Aterese ena e tšoane le lethathamo la litšokelo la buusdo.
evidenceNoMatchTitle: Ha ho tšokelo e tsejoang mananeong
evidenceNoMatchDetail: Ha ho tšokelo e tsejoang e fumanoeng lenaneong la rona. Sena ha se pake hore sebaka se bolokehile.
evidenceUnknownReputationDetail: Lenaneo la rona ha le fane ka sephetho se setle kapa se sebe.
evidenceProviderUnavailableTitle: Lethathamo la litšokelo ha le fumanehe
evidenceProviderUnavailableDetail: Lenaneo la rona ha lea khona ho baloa. Litlhahlobo tsa sebopeho le tsa hona joale li tsoetse pele.
evidenceIdentityMatchTitle: Domeine e tšoana le mokhatlo o tsejoang
evidenceIdentityMatchDetail: Domeine e ka ngolisoang e tšoana le {name}. Sena ha se bolele hore sebaka se bolokehile.
evidenceIdentityMismatchTitle: E shebahala joaloka mokhatlo o tsejoang, empa domeine ha e tšoane
evidenceIdentityMismatchDetail: Aterese e shebahala e amana le {name}, empa domeine e laolang ke {domain}.
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainTitle: Letšoao la domeine e ka tlase e khelosang
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainDetail: Lebitso le tšoanang le mokhatlo le hlaha pele ho domeine e laolang {domain}.
evidenceLookalikeDetail: Domeine ena e tšoana le domeine e tsejoang. Ho tšoana ke letšoao, eseng bopaki ba bolotsana.
evidencePunycodeDetail: Aterese e na le punycode. E ka ba molaong, empa litlhaku tse tšoanang li hloka tlhokomelo.
evidenceHttpDetail: Tlhahisoleseding e rometsoeng ka HTTP e ka pepesoa tseleng.
evidenceSensitivePathDetail: Tsela e fana ka maikutlo a hore leqephe le ka kopa tlhahisoleseding e bobebe. Netefatsa domeine ka boikemelo.
evidenceDnsOkDetail: Tlhahlobo ea hona joale e fihletse moamoheli.
evidenceDnsFailDetail: Moamoheli ha a arabela. Sebaka se ka ngoloa hampe kapa se sa fihlellehe.
evidenceRedirectChainDetail: Kopo e latetse phetisetso e le ’ngoe kapa ho feta.
evidenceCrossRedirectDetail: Aterese e fetiselitsoe ho domeine e ’ngoe e ka ngolisoang.
evidenceUnreachableDetail: Kopo ea hona joale e hlolehile.
evidenceTlsFailDetail: HTTPS ha ea khona ho netefatsoa. Se ke oa kenya tlhahisoleseding e bobebe.
evidenceIpHostDetail: Sebaka se fihlelloa ka IP ho e-na le lebitso le tloaelehileng la domeine.
evidenceRiskyTldTitle: Qetello ea domeine e sa tloaelehang
evidenceRiskyTldDetail: Qetello ena e sebelisoa hangata mekhatlong ea bolotsana. E le ’ngoe ha e pake kotsi.
evidenceDeepSubdomainTitle: Ketane ea domeine e ka tlase e sa tloaelehang
evidenceDeepSubdomainDetail: Liketane tse telele tsa domeine e ka tlase ka linako tse ling li sebelisoa ho shebahala li le semmuso.
evidenceSecretQueryDetail: Aterese e beha lekunutu ho query. Boleng ha boa bolokoa.
evidenceProbeTimeoutTitle: Tlhahlobo ea hona joale e feletsoe ke nako
evidenceProbeTimeoutDetail: Sebaka ha sea arabela ka nako.
evidenceHttpsLimitTitle: HTTPS ha e pake boitsebiso kapa tšepo
evidenceHttpsLimitDetail: HTTPS e sireletsa khokahano, empa ha e pake hore na ke mang ea tsamaisang sebaka kapa hore se tšepahala.
evidenceScopeLimitDetail: Re sekaseka aterese ka lenaneo la rona, ho tšoana ha merka, DNS, ho fihlella le liphetisetso. Ha re romele URL litšebeletsong tsa motho oa boraro.
evidenceUserBlockDetail: Moamoheli enoa o lenaneong la hau la botho (katoloso kapa app). Sebaka ha sea boloka lenaneo.
limitationFalsePosNeg: Matšoao a ka hlahisa litšoaeo tse fosahetseng kapa ho fosa kotsi e teng.
limitationNoContent: Tlhahlobo ena ha e sekaseke litaba tsa leqephe ’me ha e pake hore na ke mang ea laolang domeine.
limitationIdentityNotSafe: Ho tšoana ha boitsebiso ha ho tiisetse hore ketso e ’ngoe le e ’ngoe sebakeng e bolokehile.
limitationNoThirdParty: Li-URL ha li romeloe ho Google Safe Browsing kapa litšebeletsong tse ling tsa botumo tsa motho oa boraro.
riskLevelCriticalNote: Bopaki bo matla bo bontša hore u lokela ho tloha pele u kenya tlhahisoleseding.
riskLevelHighNote: Matšoao a mangata a temoso a ngotsoeng a hloka tlhokomelo hang-hang.
riskLevelCautionNote: Ho fumanoe ho se kholisehe ho bohlokoa kapa matšoao a temoso.
riskLevelLowEvidenceNote: Ha ho tšokelo e tsejoang e fumanoeng mehloling e hlahlobiloeng.
riskLevelUnknownNote: Ha ho bopaki bo lekaneng ho fihlela qeto e kholisehang.
recommendLeaveAndBlock: Tloha ’me u thibele domeine ena (katolosong kapa app ea teseke)
probeBlockedGenericTitle: Sebaka se thibetse tlhahlobo e iketsang
probeBlockedGenericDetail: Ho amohetsoe HTTP {status}. Sebaka se thibetse kapa se fokolitse tlhahlobo ena — seo ha se bopaki ba bolotsana. Leka aterese sebaling se tloaelehileng ha ho hlokahala.
faqCommonIntro: Likarabo tse khutšoanyane ka seo buusdo e se etsang le seo e sa se etse — li thusa pele u tšepa sephetho sa Ema.
